title: How SQL Injection Works: Hacking a Login Box in 60 Seconds 💉 #shorts
description:
SQL injection happens when an app glues user input straight into a database query. Type ' OR '1'='1 into a login box and the WHERE clause becomes always true, so the attacker logs in without a password. The fix is simple: parameterized queries keep data and code separate, so input is never run as SQL.

lines: You can log into some websites without a password. Just by typing a few strange characters.
Behind the login box, the app builds a database query by gluing your username and password straight into the text.
Now type this as the password: quote, OR, one equals one. The query becomes: password is blank, or one equals one.
One equals one is always true. So the database returns a user, and the attacker is in, with no password at all.
The fix: parameterized queries. The query and your input travel separately, so input is only ever data, never code.
Never glue input into SQL. Keep data and code apart.
